text: The Patriots face a significant challenge heading into Sunday's 1 PM ET home opener against the Pittsburgh Steelers at Gillette Stadium, as wide receiver A.J. Brown has been placed on injured reserve following a high ankle sprain suffered in Week 1, sidelining him for at least four games and forcing the question of who steps up in his absence—a question Mike Vrabel addressed in his Monday press conference. To shore up the roster in other areas, the team is adding defensive tackle DaQuan Jones on a one-year deal worth up to $6 million, while the practice squad has seen some recent churning with Elliott Davison being both re-signed and subsequently released, along with the additions of first-year wide receiver Chandler Brayboy and rookie linebacker Xavier Holmes. Off the field, owner Robert Kraft made headlines by confirming he had Macklemore removed as an opening act for Ed Sheeran's upcoming shows at Gillette Stadium, citing his history of antisemitic rhetoric and imagery that Kraft said he believed had been offensive and hurtful to the Jewish community.
